name: Leomund's Secret Chest
description:
You attempt to cause a lockable container to phase out. To cast this spell, you must be holding the container’s key in its lock. Roll Lore against a difficulty equal to the container’s length + width + height, in feet. On a pass, the container instantly phases out and remains so indefinitely.

To recall the container, cast this spell again while holding the same key, skipping the roll. The container teleports to your location and phases in, positioned so that the key is already in the lock.

The key still operates the lock normally when not casting the spell. If the key is broken or destroyed while the container is phased out, the container remains there and cannot be recalled by this spell.
successes:
✨: You first time you recall this container, you may do so as a half action and without spending the MP cost of this spell.

🌞: You may recall this container or cause it to phase out as many times as you like by using a half action and without spending the MP cost of this spell.

💀: The spell is botched. The container is broken. Roll 1d8. On a 1, one of the items in the container, chosen at random, is also broken. Check a Condition.
